info.title: Reports
info.description: The Reports objects and services let you create, run, and monitor reports.

tags.name: Reports_Retrieve stored reports
tags.description:
Retrieve logged-in user's stored report in a new format (`outputType`) or request to send a report to a new location.
If a report is stored in the Intacct database, you can request to send it to the cloud (set `outputLocation` to `cloud`). You can request a report stored in `intacct` in a specified format (`outputType`) only if it has not been requested in that format already.

get.description: Returns a collection with a key, ID, and link for each stored report.
